en.text: No, thanks. I am tired.

original: 結構です。

en.text: It's fine.

original: 精子って，結構苦いんですね。好きな人のでもこれはちょっと無理かも。

en.text: You know sperm's actually pretty bitter when you think about it. Even the people who like it are going to have limits.

original: 最初の頃は結構気を張ってたけどそのうちやっつけ仕事になったから、そんな質のいいもんじゃなかったと思うわ。

en.text: Even though I put my all into this to begin with it ended up being menial work, so I think it didn't turn out great.

original: フランス語は結構話せるほう？

en.text: Are you good at speaking French?

original: リフォームに結構お金がかかった。

en.text: I spent a lot of money remodeling my house.

original: トムは結構幸せです。

en.text: Tom is quite happy.

original: ねえ、このピザ、まずくないよ。結構いけるじゃん。

en.text: Hey, this pizza isn't bad. Not bad at all.

original: お釣りは結構です。

en.text: Keep the change.

original: もう結構です。十分いただきました。

en.text: No, thank you. I've had enough.

original: 結構です。コーヒーは飲まないので。

en.text: No, thank you. I don't drink coffee.

original: 田中先生って、ぱっと見若く見えるけど、結構年いってるらしいよ。

en.text: At a glance, Mr. Tanaka looks young, but they say he's actually rather old.

original: 僕のフランス語って結構いいと思うんだけどな。

en.text: I think my French is pretty good.
I think that my French is pretty good.

original: トムはフランス語が結構うまいと思うよ。

en.text: I think Tom is pretty good at French.
I think that Tom is pretty good at French.

original: じゃあまだ結構疲れ残ってるでしょ？

en.text: So, you're still pretty tired, aren't you?

original: 電気自動車の充電には、結構な時間がかかります。

en.text: Charging the electric car takes a very long time.
Charging the electric car takes such a long time.

original: 「このトトロのネクタイどう？」「真面目に選んでくれる？」「結構まじめに選んでるつもりなんだけど……」

en.text: "How about this Totoro tie?" "Can you give me a serious suggestion?" "I was being serious."

original: 人生、結構満喫してるよね？

en.text: You're fully enjoying life, right?
You're really enjoying life, aren't you?

original: 日本語は四字熟語って結構あるね。

en.text: There are lots of four-character compound words in Japanese, huh?

original: 自分の車を売却し、結構な利益を得た。

en.text: I made a good profit by selling my car.

original: もう結構ですからお帰りください。

en.text: I've heard enough already. Please leave.

original: 「トムって、来週会社を辞めるんだって」「おいおい！待ってくれよ、それって結構重大な事なんだけど」

en.text: "Tom said he's going to leave the company next week." "Woah! Wait a minute, that's quite a big deal isn't it?"

original: 食わず嫌いで寿司を敬遠する人もいますが、何度か食べるうちに「寿司の虜になった」という人も結構多いですよ。

en.text: There are those who distance themselves from sushi without having ever tried it, but there are also a fair number of people who have "Become captive to sushi" having only tried it a few times.

original: うちの犬は結構泳げる。

en.text: My dog can swim quite well.

original: 自分では結構泳ぎが上手いと思っていた。

en.text: I thought that I was a fairly good swimmer.
I thought I was a fairly good swimmer.

original: やるのは、結構簡単だったよ。

en.text: That was pretty easy to do.

original: 「エスペラント語って話せる？」「ほとんど話せはしないけど、理解は結構できるよ」

en.text: "Do you speak Esperanto?" "I barely speak it, but I can understand it quite well."

original: 「何か飲みますか？」「いえ、結構です」

en.text: "Do you want anything to drink?" "No, thanks."

original: 簡単そうに見えるけど、結構体力消耗するなぁ。

en.text: It looks easy, but it's pretty exhausting.

original: 結構チビなんです。

en.text: I'm pretty short.

original: 結構内容が濃かった。

en.text: The content was quite thick.

original: 僕の車、結構燃費がいいんだ。

en.text: My car gets pretty good gas mileage.

original: カバンは結構です。

en.text: No thanks, I don't need a bag.

original: このコート、結構するのよ。でも、めっちゃ気に入ってるし一先ず買っちゃおっと。

en.text: I know that this coat's very expensive. But I really like it, so I'm going to buy it anyway.

original: それって、結構な技術がいりそうね。

en.text: That looks like it takes a lot of skill.

original: 昨日買った本、結構面白かったよ。

en.text: The book I bought yesterday is pretty interesting.
The book I bought yesterday was quite interesting.
The book I bought yesterday was pretty interesting.

original: 結構ワイルドだな。

en.text: It's pretty wild.

original: 彼女の感は結構当たる。主に悪い予感のときだけ。

en.text: Her intuition is quite accurate. Especially when she predicts things are going bad.

original: トムは結構動揺してるみたい。

en.text: Tom seems quite upset.

original: 結構、几帳面だと思う。

en.text: I think it is surprisingly precise.
I think they are surprisingly precise.
